FAIL.summary: The app registration needs at least {{minimumRegistrationAdminOwners}} user owner(s) whose UPN starts with {{ownerUpnPrefix}}.
actions: In Entra admin center, open App registrations, select All applications and locate this registration using its registration Object ID or Application (client) ID.
Open Owners and add the responsible administrator account. Its UPN must start with {{ownerUpnPrefix}}.

Ensure at least {{minimumRegistrationAdminOwners}} qualifying administrator owner(s) are listed, then run the report again. Enterprise application owners are checked separately and may be different people.

UNKNOWN.summary: Registration or owner details are incomplete. The report cannot confirm whether the app registration has enough administrator owners.
actions: Ask the report administrator to check registration and owner collection, including Application.Read.All and User.Read.All consent.
Collect a new report before changing owners based on incomplete evidence.
